privileged_info_for_vlm: The observer must be at Latitude 53.6947N, Longitude 6.4755W, Altitude 75m. For the ancient date -3199-12-21 at 08:30, the Sun should be at an azimuth of approximately 134° to 135° (South-East). For the modern date 2024-12-21 at 08:30, the Sun will be at a different azimuth (approx 137°) due to axial precession. The landscape MUST be disabled (flag_landscape: false), meaning the area below the horizon line should be black/empty, while the azimuthal grid and cardinal points (S, E, SE) must be visible.
